step1_analysis.circuit_type: Switchable Bias Generator / Active Load Amplifier
step1_analysis.description: The circuit is a common-source amplifier or bias generator with a diode-connected PMOS load (XMP1) and an NMOS driver (XMN2). An additional NMOS switch (XMN1) is used to pull the gate of the driver to ground, effectively disabling the circuit and turning off the bias current.

paper_reference.title: A 13.56MHz Fully Integrated 1X/2X Active Rectifier with Compensated Bias Current for Inductively Powered Devices

dc_gain.description: Low frequency voltage gain from N2 to VB

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain ≈ gm_n2 / gm_p1. With un*Cox=270u and up*Cox=50u, gm ratio is approx sqrt(270/50) = 2.3 V/V, which is ~7.3 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on square-law model for diode-connected load in SKY130.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW ≈ gm_p1 / (2*pi*Cload). With gm_p1 ~ 100uS and Cload ~ 10fF, BW is in the hundreds of MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The diode-connected load provides a low impedance (~1/gm), resulting in a wide bandwidth suitable for the 13.56MHz system frequency.

power_consumption.description: Static power consumption when enabled (N1=0V, N2=0.9V)

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using SKY130 NMOS parameters at VDD=1.8V and typical bias.

turn_off_time.description: Delay from enable signal (N1) going high to output (VB) pulling up to VDD

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the RC time constant of the node N2 being pulled down by XMN1, and VB being pulled up by XMP1.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Small parasitic capacitances and strong drive strengths yield nanosecond-scale switching times.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, bandwidth, power consumption, and switching times of the switchable bias generator.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Switchable Bias/Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmn1=5u L_xmn1=0.5u
.param W_xmn2=5u L_xmn2=0.5u
.param W_xmp1=5u L_xmp1=0.5u

XMN1 N2 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn1} w={W_xmn1}
XMN2 VB N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmn2} w={W_xmn2}
XMP1 VB VB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmp1} w={W_xmp1}

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN2_src N2_src 0 dc 0.9 ac 1
R1 N2_src N2 10k
VN1 N1 0 dc 0 pulse(0 1.8 10n 1n 1n 40n 100n)
Cload VB 0 10f

.control
* 1. Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis
ac dec 100 1k 10G
let gain_db = vdb(VB) - vdb(N2)
meas ac dc_gain_db find gain_db at=1k
meas ac bw_3db when gain_db='dc_gain_db-3' fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis
tran 0.1n 100n
meas tran t_off trig v(N1) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(VB) val=1.6 rise=1
meas tran t_on trig v(N1) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(VB) val=1.0 fall=1

quit
.endc
.end
